recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food quality during peak hours due to lack of standardized preparation and quality control.
recommendations.action: Implement strict kitchen standard operating procedures (SOPs), including mandatory recipe cards at every station, plating reference photos on the pass, and assigning a dedicated expeditor during peak hours to perform quality checks before dishes leave the kitchen.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduction in food variance across shifts, lower rates of returned dishes, and improved overall customer satisfaction scores.
